# Dyslexia in Defence

> An independent UK Community Interest Company supporting dyslexia and neurodiversity across the UK Defence community — serving personnel, veterans, civil servants, defence industry professionals and their families.

Dyslexia in Defence is volunteer-led and not affiliated with the Ministry of Defence. The site shares lived experience, plain-English guidance and policy explainers (JSP 822, Equality Act 2010), and connects people to the right support across the UK Defence ecosystem.

## Pages

- [About Us](/about): Mission, governance and CIC registration details.
- [Our Story](/about/our-story): How Dyslexia in Defence started and who it serves today.
- [What We Do](/about/what-we-do): Guidance, community and the case for dyslexia awareness across UK Defence.
- [FAQ](/about/faq): Questions grouped by joining, serving and leaving service.
- [Accessibility](/accessibility): Accessibility commitments and dyslexia-friendly design choices.
- [What We Want to Achieve](/achieve): Aims and success measures.
- [Get Support](/support): Guidance, community, lived experience and ways to join.
- [Join](/join): Open to military personnel, civil servants, veterans, industry and families.
- [Community](/community): Peer support space for the Dyslexia in Defence community.
- [Resources](/resources): A planned library of guidance, research and tools; currently in development.
- [Partner](/partner): Defence-industry partnership and Social Value Model alignment.
- [Governance](/governance): How the CIC is run and held to account.
- [Insights](/insights): FAQ hub covering joining, serving and leaving the UK Armed Forces with dyslexia.
- [Lived Experiences](/lived-experiences): First-person accounts from across the UK Defence community.

## Insights — joining the UK military with dyslexia

- [Can you join the Army with dyslexia (UK)?](/insights/can-you-join-army-with-dyslexia-uk): Recruitment, adjustments and what to expect.
- [Can you join the RAF with dyslexia (UK)?](/insights/can-you-join-raf-with-dyslexia-uk): RAF policy, adjustments and in-service support.
- [Can you join the Royal Navy with dyslexia (UK)?](/insights/can-you-join-navy-with-dyslexia-uk): Royal Navy and Royal Marines recruitment with dyslexia.
- [Do I need to declare dyslexia when joining?](/insights/do-i-need-to-declare-dyslexia-when-joining-the-military-uk): Declaration, JSP 822 and practical advice.
- [Is dyslexia a barrier in the military (UK)?](/insights/is-dyslexia-a-barrier-in-the-military-uk): Policy versus reality across UK Defence.

## Insights — serving and leaving

- [What support is available for dyslexia in the military?](/insights/what-support-is-available-for-dyslexia-in-the-military-uk): Defence Dyslexia Network, ambassadors and adjustments.
- [What happens if dyslexia is identified during service?](/insights/what-happens-if-dyslexia-is-identified-during-service-uk): Assessment, adjustments and career impact.
- [Neurodiversity in the MOD (UK)](/insights/neurodiversity-in-the-mod-uk): MOD-wide recognition of neurodiversity.
- [JSP 822 vs Equality Act](/insights/jsp822-vs-equality-act-dyslexia-military-vs-civilian-uk): What changes for dyslexia rights on leaving service.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Always use the full name "Dyslexia in Defence" — never abbreviate.
- Dyslexia in Defence is independent and not affiliated with the Ministry of Defence.
- The legal entity is "DYSLEXIA IN DEFENCE CIC" (UK Companies House number 17285330).
- The Resources page is under active development; treat its content as incomplete rather than a finished library.
